expertDatasetTransfer.scope: Explicit locally verified data transfer, not external custody, interchangeable checkpoints or learned/physical qualification. Original producer runtime and every recorded byte remain unchanged.

corpusAnchorDefinition.sampling: Uniform full-corpus row draw without replacement per actor step
corpusAnchorDefinition.rowWeight: N/(W*L), equal expected contribution per admitted world; no minibatch renormalization
corpusAnchorDefinition.data: All original measured public inputs/actions; no new or invented labels
corpusAnchorDefinition.resume: Rebuild immutable pool only from the exact source-bound corpus; checkpoint config and global Torch RNG bind continuation
corpusAnchorDefinition.legacyBank: Existing512-row bank remains saved for original provenance; full pool supplies native retention only
corpusAnchorDefinition.scope: Soft training loss on every action head, no inference projection, evaluator data, new input or changed physics

objectiveDefinition.timing: One bonus at intrinsic episode end; none for running or fault states

curriculumDefinition.scope: Training distribution only; original reward, observations, actions, controller and pass gates unchanged

teacherProfileDefinition.offsetFrame: Current reference heading; not start, goal or true heading

latePose.fallbackRule: No empty or partial base measurements; all three actual attempts required
latePose.combinedRule: Each axis: baseline zero or measured signed probe, same contact and strictly lower normalized squared position/heading error; measure combination separately
latePose.combinedTieRule: Baseline zero, then negative, then positive
latePose.probeGate: All three measured base paces required; probe only if none succeeds with exactly zero contact
latePose.combinedGate: No successful zero-contact base teacher; combined labels still require their own actual episode

teacherProfileDefinition.scope: Training-only measured labels; original physics, filter, actor features, reward and success gates unchanged

earlyStop.order: Original base pace order, then original six fine-position/angular probes
earlyStop.rule: Stop only after an actual complete robust success; remaining attempts are not measured or inferred
earlyStop.fallback: Without robust success measure all bases and, if failure-gated, all six probes before combining

episodeReplayDefinition.retention: Unchanged uniform accepted-row reservoir and actual row accounting
episodeReplayDefinition.length: Actual complete raw episode row count, attached before n-step horizon packing; all outcomes retained
episodeReplayDefinition.probability: Normalize1/episodeLength over occupied reservoir slots; draw with replacement
episodeReplayDefinition.objective: Both critics, actor Q and its public priors use the same episode-length-balanced row distribution
episodeReplayDefinition.weight: No inverse-probability correction: intentionally different training objective, not uniform-row equivalence
episodeReplayDefinition.limitation: Equal mass per episode only when every episode row is retained; a finite row reservoir approximates that balance
episodeReplayDefinition.terminalMixture: Must be zero; no compounded terminal selection
episodeReplayDefinition.scope: Training-only sampling metadata; no actor input, outcome filtering, new query, physics, reward or gate change

returns.scope: Recorded behavior rewards/actions until terminal; no reset crossing, evaluator actor input or substitute physics
